FileByteLimit.description:
Largest size, in bytes, that a file may have.

Configuration uses it for `max_bytes_per_file`, and the ratchet file for the ceiling of a file
that was already too large.

max_lines.description: Allowed line ceiling for an existing violation.

allOf.description: Normalized repository-relative path using forward slash separators.

role.description: Production or test role measured at the file.

FileSizeRatchet.description: Byte ceiling for one file that was already larger than its byte limit.

max_bytes.description: Largest size, in bytes, the file may grow back to.

allOf.description: Normalized repository-relative path using forward slash separators.

storage.description: Where Git stored the file, which decides the byte limit it was over.

FileStorage.description: Where Git stores a file, which decides the byte limit that applies to it.

oneOf.description: Git stores the file's content, so `max_bytes_per_file` limits its size on disk.

Git LFS stores the file's content and Git stores only a small pointer to it, so
`max_bytes_per_lfs_object` limits the size of the content.

description:
Measured ceilings for current violations.

The file omits language, ownership, reasons, and configured limits. Checks derive those values
from source classification and the configured limits.

directories.description: Directory direct-file count ceilings for both source roles.

file_sizes.description: Byte ceilings for files that were already larger than their byte limit.

files.description: File line ceilings for both source roles.
